title: Authorization decision record
description: One record per authorization decision made by policies/tool_authz (control AAC-AU-01). This is the value of data.agentaccess.tool_authz.decision. A gateway writes it to the audit log; OPA's own decision log wraps it with a decision ID and timestamp.

reasons.description: Why the request was denied. Empty when allow is true.

enum: tool or action not granted to agent

agent.description: Workload identity of the calling agent.

server.description: MCP server or API the call targeted.

action.description: Action requested on the tool, such as read or write.

request_id.description: Caller-supplied request ID, for correlating this record with gateway and backend logs. Null if the request carried none.

impact.description: Impact level of the tool from policy data. Null when the tool is unknown or its metadata is invalid.

approval_granted.description: Whether the request carried a granted approval.

approver.description: Identity of the approver named in the request, if any.

allOf.description: An allowed decision has no denial reasons.
A denied decision states at least one reason.
A high-impact action is allowed only with a granted approval.
